parameters.name: image
parameters.description: The standard (low-dynamic-range) skybox image you want to convert into an HDRi environment.

parameters.name: outputExr
parameters.description: Saves the result as an OpenEXR file (.exr) - a high-dynamic-range format widely used in 3D and VFX software.

parameters.name: outputHdr
parameters.description: Saves the result as a Radiance HDR file (.hdr) - a common high-dynamic-range format for environment lighting.

parameters.name: conversionCubemapCross
parameters.description: Also outputs a cubemap in "cross" layout: the six faces of the environment unfolded into a single cross-shaped image. Applies to the input and all generated outputs.

parameters.name: conversionCubemapFaces
parameters.description: Also outputs a cubemap as six separate square face images. Applies to the input and all generated outputs.
